verdict.rationale: Cline's CLI documents cron-scheduled agents run through the hub that persist across process restarts and run independently of any terminal session. Headless runs inside GitHub Actions, GitLab or any pipeline cover triggers, and auto-approve/YOLO mode lets these agents modify files and run commands without prompts (e.g. "run tests and fix failures"). missing for 10: detailed docs on native event triggers beyond CI pipelines, depth on scheduling configuration and monitoring, independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduled autonomous maintenance.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can set up always-on agents that run on schedules or triggers to maintain and fix my software autonomously

citations.quote: The CLI supports running agents on cron schedules through the hub. Scheduled agents persist across process restarts and run independently of any terminal session.
Run agents on cron schedules for recurring automations like daily summaries and code reviews.
Run it headlessly inside GitHub Actions, GitLab, or any pipeline.
Autonomous execution can modify files and run commands without further prompts.
cline --auto-approve true "run tests and fix failures"
